Name: Shane Doomer Replacer
Author: Sharaj00
Description:
A simple mod, that changes Shane model and portrait to popular wojak meme - Doomer

[b]REQUIED[/b]: ﻿[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/999]Portraiture[/url]﻿
﻿ ﻿ ﻿[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]﻿

[b]INSTALL:[/b] 1. [url=https://smapi.io/]Install the latest version of SMAPI
﻿ ﻿ ﻿[/url]2. Unzip the both folder into Stardew Valley/Mods
﻿ ﻿ ﻿3. Run the game using SMAPI.
﻿ ﻿ ﻿4. In the game, press [b]P [/b]to scroll [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/999]Portraiture[/url]﻿ portraits. Select [b]Shane Doomer[/b] portraits.
